shortDescription: RPSC Sub Inspector / Platoon Commander 2025 written examination was scheduled for 5 April 2026. The PET admit card/release date is not officially verified yet.
content:
Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has scheduled the Sub Inspector / Platoon Commander Combined Competitive Examination 2025.

According to the official RPSC examination calendar, the written examination is scheduled for 5 April 2026. Candidates qualifying the written examination will proceed to the Physical Efficiency Test as prescribed under the recruitment rules.

The official RPSC website should be treated as the final source for the PET schedule and call letter. The PET admit card release date should not be marked as released until an official RPSC notice or admit-card link confirms it.
